name: Oriel
note: The one source of Oriel's design values, and the target the code moves to (#522): internal/ui/theme is to be generated from this file and layout.json, screen by screen; until a screen has moved, the hand-written theme and the tables in design/tokens.md describe what it draws. The design artifacts listed in design/README.md take the values from it. Change a value here first. design/tokens.md explains the reasons; docs/design.md the rules.

ink.usage: Every alpha fill, line and state is ink at an alpha, so it sits on any surface and steps in lightness, not hue. Light ink is rgb(37,34,30), dark ink rgb(234,240,238).

color.mygo: A token with a mygo field sets that role of MyGo's ui.Theme, so MyGo's own controls draw with it: fill is the face of a field or button, line the Border. The pane's tokens set the roles of the pane theme. Every other token is read by name from internal/ui/theme.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The window, the toolbar bar and the timeline: warm paper in light, graphite with a hint of teal in dark. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The reader's page, toolbar bar, text, links, code, notes and AI card. Equal to paper; a reading preset replaces this region and the roles drawn on it, nothing else.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Things that sit on a region: code blocks, notes, plain cards, fields, picture placeholders. No rim and no shadow in the flow.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: Things that float over content: dialogs, the command palette, the key sheet, select menus, the font picker, a focused search. Opaque, with line2 and a sheet shadow.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: The resting face of a control: the segmented trough, the search field, inline code, a monogram tile, a skeleton bar. Step 1 of the state ladder.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered row or control. Step 2.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The chosen row, navigation item or menu item. Step 3: darker than hover, so a hovered chosen row still reads as chosen. Neutral, never tinted with the accent.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed. Step 4, the deepest, so pressing a chosen row still shows.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The chosen segment of a segmented control or capsule, lighter than its fill trough, with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text. Target 10:1 on every text bed.

tokens.name: prose
tokens.usage: The reading body, a step softer than fg for long reading. Target 8.5:1.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Source names, summaries, the unselected labels of a segmented control, unselected names. Target 7:1.

tokens.name: fg3
tokens.usage: Icons and glyphs of controls (toolbar icons, row actions at rest). Target 5.5:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta, times, counts, read titles, hints, placeholders. Target 4.5:1 on every bed, the fill and the selected row included, so no screen needs an exception.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs only, never the only copy of a label. Target 2.6:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oriel's one color, a muted teal that does not follow the system accent: the unread dot, links, the primary button, a chosen icon, the selection marker, the AI card's head. Target 4.5:1 (it is link text).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary button.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. 4.5:1 on accent.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A starred entry: the only hue besides the accent and status. A graphic, never text. Target 3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive actions; may be text. Always with words or a symbol. Target 4.5:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The server dot and positive results; may be text. Target 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution; a graphic, never text. Target 3:1.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: The alpha of a meaning color behind an icon or a status: the AI card, a note, a health line, an on toolbar button. soft(accent), soft(danger).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, 2 DIPs, always visible. 3:1 as a control boundary.

tokens.name: link-underline
tokens.usage: A link's underline at rest; accent on hover.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts: a charcoal tile.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Ivory text on inverse.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: The duration and picture-count badge on a cover, with white caption text.

tokens.name: viewer
tokens.usage: The image viewer's opaque ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and dividers inside cards. Never around a card or a control.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Rims: floats, raised segments, form edges, the 0.5 DIP outline of an image.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: A quote's line in prose.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thumbs, 6 DIPs wide.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The color of shadow-popup and shadow-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: The color of shadow-dialog.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: logo-body
tokens.usage: The mark's ink drop, with the arcs cut out of it. It keeps the brand ink, within a step of fg; never used in the interface.

tokens.name: logo-piece
tokens.usage: The mark's dot, the one teal piece; the product icon draws it as a sphere from #5eead4 to #0f766e. Never used in the interface.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: The product icon's warm ivory tile, the same in both schemes (a gradient from #fdfcf9 to #e6e0d5 in the icon).

pane.note: The ink pane, the sidebar: an opaque region inset 8 from the window, radius 14, warm charcoal in light and deep teal in dark. It is Oriel's bay window. Its own roles replace the main ones while the sidebar is built (theme.PaneTheme); everything not listed here keeps the main value.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: The pane's ground.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Resting face of a control in the pane: the filter field.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered pane item.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Chosen pane item, with its icon in accent.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed pane item.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: The chosen name; headings. Target 8:1.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Names, icons on hover, counts on a chosen or hovered item. Target 6:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Counts, section heads, icons at rest. Target 4.5:1.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs. Target 2.6:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The chosen item's icon; icons only, never text. Target 3:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines in the pane.

presets.note: Reading appearance presets replace the page region and the roles drawn on it, in the reader's content area only. Each has a light and a dark variant that follows the app's scheme. accent-hover is accent mixed 17% toward fg in light and 12% toward white in dark; accent-pressed 30% toward fg in light and 12% toward black in dark. Alpha fills are the preset ink at the main ladder's alphas. warning and success keep the theme's values. focus is accent at 80%.

high-contrast.note: With the desktop's high contrast on. Applies to the main roles, the pane and the presets alike.

audit.note: Text beds are the grounds text is drawn on, built by stacking the tokens. Every text token must meet its target on its worst bed, in every scheme and preset; once the theme is generated (#522), a theme test computes this and a change that fails cannot merge. WCAG 2.x contrast.

shadow.name: shadow-popup
shadow.usage: Select menus, the font picker. Radius card, rim 0.5 line2 (1 DIP white 8% in dark).

shadow.name: shadow-dialog
shadow.usage: Dialogs, the command palette, the key sheet. Radius sheet, same rim.

opacity.note: Opacity is taken only from here, never written in a view. A disabled control does not fade: its glyph takes faint and its label stays muted. A meaning color behind an icon takes soft, not an opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-faded
tokens.usage: Something still there that has stepped back: a rule that is turned off, a subscription row locked while a change runs.

tokens.name: opacity-separator
tokens.usage: The middle dot between the parts of a meta line, on muted.

space.note: Multiples of Theme.Spacing (4 at default; 3 compact, 5 roomy), so density scales them. Values at default.

radius.note: By role. Scale with the text size like every size. A pill or circle is half its height.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Site icons and small tiles, inline code, badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows in a popup, select options, segments, row actions, strip pictures.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls, pane items, thumbnails, the compact row, a settings segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Entry rows, code blocks, notes, pictures and covers, popups.

tokens.name: radius-pane
tokens.usage: The ink pane, the AI card.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules, segments in a capsule, dots, the new-entries pill.

size.note: Fixed sizes, in DIPs at the default text size; they scale with it (theme.Px).

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons beside 12 and 13 text: in buttons, fields, menus, status lines, the meta line.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Bare icon buttons, a row's leading icon, icons beside 15 text.

tokens.name: icon-l
tokens.usage: States: empty, loading, done, a failed picture, the viewer's arrows.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Every Lucide icon.

tokens.name: tile-s
tokens.usage: Site icon or monogram in a meta line, the reader, a candidate row.

tokens.name: tile-m
tokens.usage: Site icon or monogram in the pane.

tokens.name: tile-l
tokens.usage: Site icon or monogram in the subscriptions list.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Row actions, the add button's hit area.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Menu items, popup rows, the pane filter, icon buttons in the pane.

tokens.name: pane-row
tokens.usage: A kind, a subscription, a folder or a settings group in the pane.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, toolbar icon buttons, capsules.

tokens.name: control-small
tokens.usage: Small buttons; a segment inside a capsule.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: An article in the Compact viewer.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: The toolbar bar; the window buttons sit on its middle line.

tokens.name: pane-width
tokens.usage: The ink pane; 184 below a 760 wide window (pane-width-narrow).

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Timeline rows and the reader column at Medium, Standard.

tokens.name: column-social
tokens.usage: Social rows in the timeline.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: The widest a centered sheet grows (connect).

tokens.name: menu-min
tokens.usage: The narrowest select menu.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: An article's picture, 96 x 64.

tokens.name: marker-w
tokens.usage: The selection marker, 2.5 x 18, radius 2.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The unread dot.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Image outline and float rims in light.

font.note: Families are lists; the first installed one draws. Screens never set a family of their own except mono.

families.name: sans
families.usage: The interface, and the reading body by default: the platform's UI font (Font left empty), or the family chosen as Interface font in Settings, Appearance.

families.name: serif
families.usage: The reading body when Reading font is Serif; the interface font when none is installed. The body only: titles, h2, h3, notes and captions keep sans.

families.name: mono
families.usage: The code styles and the reading code: rewrite rules, prompts, addresses, code in an article. MyGo's generic monospace, the platform's own.

text.note: The only interface text styles. Hierarchy comes from lightness first (fg, fg2, muted), then weight, then size. The default text size is 13 (MyGo's Theme.FontSize); every size scales with it. Weights 400, 500, 600. Line heights in DIPs at the default text size; zh is Simplified Chinese, which runs taller. Tracking in em. Counts, times and durations use tabular numerals. The reading body and its headings are the separate reading scale.

styles.name: display-compact
styles.usage: The reader title in a window narrower than 760.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Row titles, section heads, screen titles, the 32 tile's letter, the +N tile.

styles.name: body-prose
styles.usage: Body text read as prose: the summary card.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, pane items, fields.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, hints, status lines, notes, toasts, the shortcut sheet's action names.

styles.name: meta-strong
styles.usage: The source name in a meta line, segments, the capsule.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section heads in the pane, counts, durations, key caps, badges.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Monospace fields: rewrite rules, prompts, addresses.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Code inside body text, inline or in a block.

derived.name: tile-letter
derived.usage: The letter of a monogram tile; follows the tile, so it is not a style.

reading.note: The reader's article text: the sixth scale, set by the reading preferences. Values at Medium, Standard.

motion.note: Oriel moves little. Motion answers only two questions: where did this come from (a popup grows out of its control, a folder opens in place) and what just happened (a fill under the pointer, a toast). It never decorates, loops or hides latency. Only color, opacity, a popup's small scale and a fold change; nothing slides. Curves are fixed-duration ease-out, never springs or overshoot: small things motion-fast, a fold or a toast motion-base, nothing longer except the spinner. Leaving is never slower than arriving. A new state starts from where the old one is, so every change can be interrupted. Keyboard actions are immediate. With reduced motion, scale and folds are immediate and only fades of motion-fast or less remain; the spinner keeps turning.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and chosen fills and text color; row actions fading in; a popup or menu scaling from popup-scale with a fade.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Folding a folder or a collapsed group open and shut; a toast coming and going.

tokens.name: spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the busy spinner.

tokens.name: popup-scale
tokens.usage: The scale a popup or menu starts from.
